name: @caisson/platform-migrations
description: The ONE ordered platform migration chain (CAISSON-21). Extracted from apps/site/lib/deploy-migrate.ts's platformPackage(), which used to be the sole owner, hand-mirrored by apps/admin's PGlite bootstrap by SQL-constant name — a drift class that already bit once (CAISSON-11). Both consumers now assemble/apply the SAME ordered array via `platformMigrationsPackage`/`applyAll`, so a new migration lands for both or neither. Never published — private, internal engineering plumbing.
